text: Well played! That was a beautiful move.
Remind me to think twice before challenging you again.
Congratulations! I thought I had you for a moment.
Enjoy your victory, Fibonacci. I intend to make it a rare occurrence.
An excellent move. Infuriating, naturally, but excellent.
I demand a rematch. Purely in the interest of scientific inquiry.
That was amazing! You really caught me by surprise!
You could have warned me you were going to be this good!
I was cheering for you! Well, until I remembered I was your opponent.
Good game! You nearly had me there.
Don't look so gloomy. There's always the next match!
That was closer than it looked. Care for another round?
A predictable outcome, of course. Though you did make me work for it.
Don't be discouraged, Fibonacci. Losing to me is a valuable educational experience.
You nearly had me with that last combination. Nearly being the operative word.
Oh, I won! Sorry, I didn't mean to sound so surprised!
That was fun! And don't worry, I promise not to brag. Much.
Want another go? I'll try to be gentle. No promises, though!
